achievements.name: Cannon Launch
achievements.detail: Spot an island with the telescope, then fire Mario and Luigi onto it from Shipshape's cannon.

achievements.name: Island Linked
achievements.detail: Reach an island's lighthouse and reconnect that island to Shipshape.

achievements.name: UFO Spin
achievements.detail: Unlock UFO Spin and cross a gap by spinning the brothers into a flying disc.

achievements.name: Bro Ball
achievements.detail: Unlock Bro Ball and roll the brothers through a tight pipe.

achievements.name: Fire and Ice
achievements.detail: Learn the Bros. Move that lets the brothers wield fire and ice.

achievements.name: Bros. Attack
achievements.detail: Perform a Bros. Attack and time each brother's button press so the hit lands harder.

achievements.name: Luigi Logic
achievements.detail: Trigger Luigi Logic and let Luigi clear an obstacle on his own.

achievements.name: Battle Plug
achievements.detail: Equip a Battle Plug and carry its effect into a fight.

achievements.name: Side Quest
achievements.detail: Complete a side quest for someone living in Concordia.

achievements.name: Great Lighthouse
achievements.detail: Reach a sea's Great Lighthouse and reveal more islands to visit.

achievements.name: New Uni-Tree
achievements.detail: Help Connie grow the new Uni-Tree by linking islands back to Shipshape.

achievements.name: Bowser Bout
achievements.detail: Win a battle against Bowser after he turns up in Concordia.

achievements.name: Concordia Whole
achievements.detail: Finish the voyage and see Concordia's scattered islands brought back together.
